name: Rashi Goyal
title: Associate AI Engineer
tagline: Building end-to-end AI systems and production-grade software architectures.
summary: Associate AI Engineer with a Master's from IIT Kharagpur, specializing in AI/ML and production-grade software architectures. Backed by professional experience building end-to-end AI systems, deploying cloud-native architectures (AWS Bedrock), and optimizing relational/vector database pipelines. Two-time National Hackathon Winner with strong foundations in Data Structures and Algorithms (C++) and international research exposure. Proven ability to deliver scalable, client-ready software within fast-paced Agile environments.

bullets: Designed the validation workflow to combine deterministic rules and AI-based semantic comparisons, using code for structured checks and AI models for ambiguous product and content comparisons in Digital Shelf Compliance.

Automated large-scale validation using Playwright, replacing a manual process that would take significant time to validate hundreds of products across multiple retailers; AI-assisted analysis to review validation accuracy.

Architected and deployed end-to-end agentic AI systems using Amazon Bedrock, implementing custom guardrails, prompt workflows, and real-time API-driven tool invocations; evaluated system behavior using golden query datasets.
Built cloud-native data and API workflows using AWS Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and CloudFront, supporting scalable data processing and application delivery.
Spearheaded development of a React Native mobile application, managing cross-platform frontend-to-backend.
Engineered background service communication logic by integrating push/email notification architectures via Firebase/GCP and worked on various other features.
Built end-to-end production pipelines for enterprise document intelligence utilizing LangChain and LlamaIndex.
Designed an optimized Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline, configuring a Chroma Vector Database to execute highly efficient, low-latency semantic search queries.
Developed scalable Python pipelines for geophysical predictive modeling and rigorous data validation.
Automated complex analysis workflows to ensure strict reproducibility and system scalability across large datasets.

projects.title: Dark Pattern Buster
projects.description: An end-to-end Chrome extension using a fine-tuned RoBERTa classifier to detect dark patterns on ecommerce websites in real time, with live scoring. National Winner, Dark Pattern Buster Hackathon 2023.

projects.title: Vessel Trajectory Prediction
projects.description: An encoder-decoder LSTM model predicting vessel trajectories and estimating oil usage, reducing simulated collision tracking margins by up to 30%. National Winner, Smart India Hackathon 2023.

projects.title: Doctor Recommendation App
projects.description: A multi-factor recommendation engine surfacing the top 3 matching doctors from a plain-English illness description, using TF-IDF and cosine similarity, hosted on AWS. Grand Finalist, Google Girl's Hackathon 2024.

projects.title: Lunar Crater Detection
projects.description: A novel lunar crater detection pipeline with automated bounding-box tuning on a YOLOv11 backbone for crater classification on satellite imagery. KL Chopra Award Nominee, Best Master's Thesis.
